{{Top|leg}}
The '''Second Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|Company]] within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> during [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'' to around [[3643 BBY]].</ref> They served in [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]], during this operation, the [[Auriga Fire]], containing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]], former [[Republic trooper|Republic Trooper]] [[Larin Moxla]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jet Nebula]], [[Imperial Agent]] [[Ula Vii]], and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Hetchkee]], joined their [[Company/Legends|Company]], until [[Jet Nebula]] disobeyed orders and broke off from the [[Company/Legends|Company]].<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />
